name: CIS (Center for Internet Security)
description: Develops and maintains consensus-based cybersecurity best practices including CIS Controls (prioritized security practices) and CIS Benchmarks (100+ vendor-neutral configuration guides).

peerReview.processDescription: CIS Controls: International community of experts developing prioritized best practices through iterative review. CIS Benchmarks: 100+ vendor-neutral configuration guides with multi-round peer review by SMEs, practitioners, and vendors.

attribution.attributionNotes: CIS Controls and Benchmarks globally recognized. CIS-CAT Pro enables measurable compliance verification.

povsAlignment.description: Consensus-based security best practices with community-driven peer review.
